title: Trust Score Algorithm
last_note: Implementation complete. mvnw.cmd compile + test-compile: BUILD SUCCESS. TrustScoreCalculatorTest: 8/8 pass. RequestLimitTest: 3/3 pass. Key design decision (not explicit in ticket, documented here): Rating entity (T041) has NO numeric 1-5 field, only a tags JSON string - so TrustScoreCalculator derives a per-rating numeric value from tags (baseline 5.0, minus penalties for negative tags, abusive/asked_for_money doubled), rather than averaging an existing score field. Introduced RatingSnapshot(occurredAt, List<RatingTag>) as the calculator's pure input type instead of depending on the Rating JPA entity directly or List<Rating> - keeps the calculator decoupled from persistence/JSON-parsing concerns (Dependency Inversion/Interface Segregation), per Rating.java's own comment that tag deserialization belongs to a mapper/service layer, not the entity. RequestLimit.wireValue() added to the existing enum exactly as specified (UNLIMITED->Integer.MAX_VALUE, THROTTLED->3, SUSPENDED->0), enum values/names unchanged. BadgeLevel.java untouched (no changes needed). No CLI codegen commands involved - plain file authoring only.
